The rate-characterization flagship is compared substantively only with Lee and COLA, while the cited counterfactual/attrition and length-optimization works (notably Lei--Candes, Song, and Kiyani--Pappas--Hassani) lack theorem-level relevance and non-overlap comparisons; add those comparisons and delimit exactly why their coverage/oracle results do not establish this deterministic Lee-oracle root-n profile.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived exact finite-sample honesty across abandonment discontinuities, pointwise deterministic-oracle contact, and matched root-n upper/lower bounds in the stated regular regime; math review passed and all five cited nodes were verified from primary sources. Independent validity confirmed achieved incremental below the field floor: the converse is generic no-selection allocation, the K=1/discontinuous-length and randomized-oracle regimes remain open, and no computational/finite-sample evidence was delivered. The related-work comparison finding remains unrepaired and disclosed; no Lean formalization, F7 promotion, presentation, or git commit was performed.
tldr: For a fixed bounded score and a finite public partition, Lee's known full-law compatibility class yields the sharp worst-case counterfactual risk and the continuous-score saturation diagnostic on \(\mathcal B_K\), with only aggregate positive always-selected mass. On the further public-floor trial subclass \(\mathcal M_{K,\mu,\lambda}\), an explicit finite integrated-budget optimizer is exactly marginally ninety-percent honest at every sample size and has uniform positive-part expected-length excess \(O(n^{-1/2})\) against the deterministic population oracle. At every fixed observed law satisfying both stated CDF continuity conditions, its full-set reporting probability vanishes and its thresholds contact the deterministic oracle argmin set, including abandonment boundaries. For \(K\geq2\) and continuous length CDFs, a bounded no-selection two-point family gives a matching positive root-\(n\) converse and the fastest-benchmark characterization. Constant scores have zero profile for every positive benchmark. The unresolved score regimes are nonconstant one-cell scores and nonconstant scores with discontinuous length CDFs. Compatibility and generic conformal allocation are credited ingredients; empirical shortening and randomized-oracle optimality are outside scope.
gap: Lee explicitly distinguishes full and reduced information but does not characterize their feasible regions for an identical vector action class. Standard allocation consistency does not address a deterministic length value with a discontinuity from below in its error budget.
fill: The iff diagnostic and sharp population risk require only aggregate selected-control positivity on the bounded finite-alphabet Lee class. The legal strict length example and five-family confidence certificate retain the deterministic-oracle kernel. Uniform confidence and oracle-length guarantees are stated on the public-floor trial subclass, with observed-score and separately maintained uniform-probe continuity additionally required for pointwise equality and argmin contact. Outward feasibility and vanishing safety mixing attain its deterministic benchmark; the fastest benchmark with finite deterministic-contact normalized minimax profile remains open, including whether the confidence logarithm can be removed at abandonment contacts.
